display.purpose: Page-level hero headings. Used once per view maximum. Reserved for the most important headline on any screen.

headline.purpose: Section titles, modal headers, empty-state callouts. The primary organizational unit within a view.

title.purpose: Card headings, sidebar section labels, tab titles. Sub-section hierarchy within a content group.

body.purpose: All prose content. Max line length 65–75ch in reading contexts. Never narrower than 45ch. Default for all paragraph-level text.

label.purpose: UI labels, button text, badge text, metadata, form field labels. Always medium weight to maintain legibility at small sizes.

arabic-display.purpose: Display-scale headings in RTL (Arabic) contexts. Wider line-height than Latin display to accommodate Arabic ascenders and descenders.

arabic-body.purpose: Body text in RTL contexts. Almarai at 1.7 line-height. Never apply letter-spacing or text-transform to this role.

arabic-label.purpose: UI labels and small text in RTL contexts. Same weight as Latin label but wider line-height.

shadows.name: card-rest-light
shadows.purpose: Default card surface at rest in light mode. Subtle separation from the page background.

shadows.name: card-rest-dark
shadows.purpose: Default card surface at rest in dark mode. More pronounced to separate surfaces on a deep background.

shadows.name: button-ambient
shadows.purpose: Primary button default shadow. Conveys weight and call-to-action prominence without drama.

shadows.name: button-hover
shadows.purpose: Applied alongside translateY(-2px) on primary button hover. Deepening shadow amplifies the lift.

shadows.name: button-blue-ambient
shadows.purpose: Secondary (Interface Blue) button ambient shadow. Color-matched glow.

shadows.name: button-blue-hover
shadows.purpose: Secondary button hover shadow. Applied with translateY(-2px).

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Modern glass card hover state. Applied alongside translateY(-8px). Large diffuse shadow simulates significant lift.

shadows.name: active-selection
shadows.purpose: Active/selected item in sidebar navigation. Combined with scale-[1.02] to signal selection state.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for all hover transitions, state changes, and UI animations. Used at 0.3–0.4s duration.

motion.name: ease-in-standard
motion.purpose: For elements exiting the screen. Things leaving should accelerate, not linger.

motion.name: ease-out-standard
motion.purpose: For elements entering the screen. Things arriving should decelerate into position.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Micro-interactions: focus rings, checkbox toggles, icon color changes.

motion.name: duration-base
motion.purpose: Standard transition duration for hover states, button lifts, card hovers.

motion.name: duration-slow
motion.purpose: Larger surface transitions: card hover with significant translateY, gradient-shift animations.

motion.name: duration-gradient
motion.purpose: Animated gradient background cycle (background-position keyframes). Never used for interactive states.

motion.name: stagger-children
motion.purpose: Framer Motion staggerChildren delay between list/grid items during reveal animations.

motion.name: stagger-delay
motion.purpose: Framer Motion delayChildren — time before the first child begins its animation after the container is visible.

motion.name: hover-lift-sm
motion.purpose: Lift amount for buttons and small interactive elements on hover.

motion.name: hover-lift-lg
motion.purpose: Lift amount for modern-card glass cards on hover.

motion.name: scale-active
motion.purpose: Scale applied to selected sidebar items and active navigation states.

breakpoints.name: xs
breakpoints.purpose: Small phones. Minimum viable layout adjustments.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Standard mobile breakpoint. Full mobile optimizations apply below this.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Tablet portrait. Two-column layouts begin. Chat list/window split activates.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: iPad Air 7 and similar. Custom breakpoint for tablet-specific nav spacing.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Desktop. Full navigation shell, sidebar + content layouts, header desktop mode.

breakpoints.name: xl
breakpoints.purpose: Large desktop. Max content widths engage.

zIndex.name: header
zIndex.purpose: Sticky top header. Below sidebar on mobile.

zIndex.name: sidebar
zIndex.purpose: Subject sidebar and mobile nav overlay.

zIndex.name: popover
zIndex.purpose: Dropdown menus, tooltips anchored to elements.

zIndex.name: tooltip
zIndex.purpose: Floating tooltips. Always above everything else.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action. Navy at rest, lifts and deepens on hover. Used for submit, enroll, download actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; background: #0f172a; color: #ffffff; padding: 8px 16px; height: 40px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(15,23,42,0.2); transition: background 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3b82f6; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(15,23,42,0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #ffffff, 0 0 0 4px #0f172a; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Interface Blue fill. Navigation-adjacent actions, secondary CTAs on the home screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #3b82f6; color: #ffffff; padding: 8px 16px; height: 40px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(59,130,246,0.2); transition: background 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #0ea5e9; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(59,130,246,0.3); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #ffffff, 0 0 0 4px #3b82f6; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent background. Used in toolbars, inline actions, and icon-adjacent labels where a filled button would be too heavy.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; color: #0f172a; padding: 8px 16px; height: 40px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #f1f5f9; } .dark .ds-btn-ghost { color: #f8fafc; } .dark .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #1e293b; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #3b82f6; }

components.name: Glass Card (modern-card)
components.description: The primary content surface for summary cards, quiz cards, and course cards. Glass morphism over a blurred background. Lifts significantly on hover.
components.html:
ملخص الفصل الأول

مقدمة في علم الأحياء الجزيئي
components.css: .ds-glass-card { border-radius: 24px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.5); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -5px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); padding: 20px; transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), border-color 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-glass-card:hover { transform: translateY(-8px); box-shadow: 0 30px 60px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.2); border-color: #3b82f6; } .dark .ds-glass-card { background: rgba(15,23,42,0.8); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); box-shadow: 0 20px 40px -10px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); } .ds-glass-card-title { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: #0f172a; margin: 0 0 8px; } .dark .ds-glass-card-title { color: #f8fafc; } .ds-glass-card-desc { font-size: 0.875rem; color: #64748b; margin: 0; } .dark .ds-glass-card-desc { color: #94a3b8; }

components.name: Base Card
components.description: Utility card for admin panels, settings sections, and containers where transparency would create visual noise.
components.css: .ds-base-card { border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; background: #ffffff; color: #0f172a; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); } .dark .ds-base-card { background: #1f2937; border-color: #1e293b; color: #f8fafc; } .ds-base-card-header { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 24px; } .ds-base-card-title { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.025em; margin: 0; } .ds-base-card-content { padding: 0 24px 24px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form field. Full-width, undecorated. Focus ring is precise, no glow.
components.css: .ds-input { display: flex; height: 40px; width: 100%; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; background: #ffffff; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #0f172a; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; font-family: inherit; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #64748b; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #3b82f6; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(59,130,246,0.2); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; } .dark .ds-input { background: #020617; border-color: #1e293b; color: #f8fafc; } .dark .ds-input::placeholder { color: #94a3b8; } .dark .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #60a5fa; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(96,165,250,0.2); } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-input { font-size: 16px; } }

components.name: Sidebar Lecture Item
components.description: Lecture navigation item in the subject sidebar. Unselected is transparent with hover fill. Selected shows blue tint, border, shadow, and slight scale.
components.css: .ds-sidebar-item { display: block; width: 100%; text-align: start; padding: 16px; border-radius: 16px; border: 2px solid transparent; background: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-sidebar-item:hover { background: #f8fafc; } .ds-sidebar-item--active { background: #eff6ff; border-color: #3b82f6; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); transform: scale(1.02); } .dark .ds-sidebar-item { background: #0f172a; color: #f8fafc; } .dark .ds-sidebar-item:hover { background: rgba(30,41,59,0.5); } .dark .ds-sidebar-item--active { background: rgba(30,58,138,0.2); border-color: #60a5fa; } .ds-sidebar-item-label { display: block; font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a; margin-bottom: 8px; } .dark .ds-sidebar-item-label { color: #f8fafc; }

components.name: Metadata Badge
components.description: Small inline tag for exam metadata (date, type, subject). Color-coded by category, always paired with an emoji icon for color-blind accessibility.
components.html: 📅 2024-01-15📝 اختبار نهائي📚 أحياء
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1rem; } .ds-badge--blue { background: #dbeafe; color: #1d4ed8; } .ds-badge--green { background: #d1fae5; color: #065f46; } .ds-badge--purple { background: #ede9fe; color: #5b21b6; } .dark .ds-badge--blue { background: rgba(59,130,246,0.15); color: #93c5fd; } .dark .ds-badge--green { background: rgba(16,185,129,0.15); color: #6ee7b7; } .dark .ds-badge--purple { background: rgba(139,92,246,0.15); color: #c4b5fd; }

components.name: Skeleton Loader
components.description: Placeholder for loading content. Matches the shape and size of the content it replaces. Uses a shimmer animation that respects prefers-reduced-motion.
components.css: .ds-skeleton { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f1f5f9 25%, #e2e8f0 50%, #f1f5f9 75%); background-size: 200% 100%; animation: ds-shimmer 1.5s infinite; border-radius: 8px; } .dark .ds-skeleton { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #1e293b 25%, #334155 50%, #1e293b 75%); background-size: 200% 100%; } @keyframes ds-shimmer { 0% { background-position: 200% 0; } 100% { background-position: -200% 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-skeleton { animation: none; background: #f1f5f9; } .dark .ds-skeleton { background: #1e293b; } }

narrative.northStarDescription: Masar X is a high-performance tool first, an educational platform second. It borrows the purposeful density of Linear, the calm intelligence of Notion, and the responsive precision of Raycast, then applies them to a bilingual academic context where Arabic and English are co-equal scripts and dark mode is a welfare decision, not an aesthetic one.
narrative.bilingualNote: This system is RTL-native. Every layout decision, type choice, and directional affordance is tested in both Arabic (Almarai/RTL) and English (Inter/LTR) before being considered final. RTL is not an afterthought.
dos: Use dark mode as the primary design target
Mirror all directional elements in RTL: arrows, chevrons, progress bars, slide-in panels
Set line-height: 1.7 for Arabic body text; Arabic needs more vertical breathing room
Constrain Amber Catalyst to actions and AI indicators only
Use cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) at 0.3-0.4s for all hover and state transitions
Use prefers-reduced-motion to disable translateY, scale, and stagger animations
Keep touch targets at min-height: 44px minimum, 48px preferred on mobile
Use icon + color for all semantic states — never color alone
Cap body prose at 65-75ch in reading contexts
Set font-size: 16px on all form inputs to prevent iOS zoom on focus
donts: Do not use gradient text (background-clip: text with a gradient). The .text-gradient-primary and .text-gradient-secondary classes exist in the codebase but violate the design language.
Do not stack glass surfaces. Never nest a glass card inside another glass container.
Do not reproduce the legacy LMS pattern: dense sidebar with 20+ items, no visual hierarchy.
Do not use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Do not apply letter-spacing other than normal to Arabic text. Do not apply text-transform: uppercase to Arabic.
Do not use bounce or elastic easing. No spring physics.
Do not animate CSS layout properties (width, height, top, left, margin, padding).
Do not use glassmorphism without a structural reason.
Do not use the hero-metric template: big number, small label, supporting stats, gradient accent.
Do not build identical card grids: same-sized cards with icon + heading + text repeated with no variation.
Do not use modals as a first response. Prefer inline expansion, side panels, progressive disclosure.
